Presented by National Geographic Society in partnership with @ROLEX 

Our oceans face many threats, but thanks to the work of National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Explorers, there are also many reasons to be hopeful about the future. 

Note: Footage from the Southern Ocean was taken during the National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Southern Ocean Expedition conducted in collaboration with the Schmidt Ocean Institute aboard their research vessel Falkor (too).

Rolex and The National Geographic Society are partnering on select science-based expeditions to explore, study, and document change in the planet’s unique regions. #PerpetualPlanet

Narrated by Auliʻi Cravalho, #ExpeditionSavingOurSeas is now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.

author: National Geographic
description:
Gather around the ultimate table and celebrate Thanksgiving through the universal language of food, family, and tradition in this holiday MEGA episode special from National Geographic. Travel alongside three food connoisseurs—Gordon Ramsay, Stanley Tucci, and Antoni Porowski—as they embark on culinary road trips across Spain and Italy to uncover time-honored dishes and modern cooking techniques. 

First, join Gordon Ramsay and his daughter Tilly along the coast of Galicia to explore culinary traditions of Spain. Next, travel with Stanley Tucci through Lombardy to witness how forward-thinking chefs are redefining classic Italian food. Finally, join Antoni Porowski and actor Justin Theroux on an Italian road trip to track down the origins of a cherished family pasta recipe. 

Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted - Spain’s Galician Coast - 00:00 
Gordon and his daughter Tilly explore centuries-old culinary traditions in Galicia, a largely overlooked, magnificent corner of Spain.
